notes.content: 1. Access the University Catalog for Programs and Degrees, General Education Requirements, and Graduation Requirements at CSUCI. 2. Access the Program Website and Program Information in the University Catalog. 3. Access Transfer 2-year or Freshman 4-year Academic Roadmaps. 4. Access the Admissions website for CSUCI admission requirements. 5. Access the Transfer Credit website for information about Associate Degrees for Transfer, and transfer credit resources for external exams and U.S. Military service. 6. Learn more About CSUCI . Articulation agreements are subject to change from one academic year to the next. It is recommended to review the applicable department agreement(s) in addition to the major agreement and that students meet with a counselor/academic advisor early and often during their academic career.
notes.contentHtml:
1. Access the University Catalog for Programs and Degrees, General Education Requirements, and Graduation Requirements at CSUCI.

2. Access the Program Website and Program Information in the University Catalog.

3. Access Transfer 2-year or Freshman 4-year Academic Roadmaps.

4. Access the Admissions website for CSUCI admission requirements.

5. Access the Transfer Credit website for information about Associate Degrees for Transfer, and transfer credit resources for external exams and U.S. Military service.

6. Learn more About CSUCI.

Articulation agreements are subject to change from one academic year to the next. It is recommended to review the applicable department agreement(s) in addition to the major agreement and that students meet with a counselor/academic advisor early and often during their academic career.
